notes: Small update to the shared look; nothing changes for you here.
Notes lift when you drag them, the others slide out of the way, and the note settles into its place.
Buttons have a little depth and feel pressed when you click them.
Checkboxes, toggles and options animate when you pick them, and folding sections open smoothly.
The link dialog has an icon and a Close button in the corner, and it spaces things out more.
Menus and tooltips open out of the spot they belong to, and buttons dip a little when you press them.
Text fields and dropdowns look calmer in Dark mode.
Patch notes for this module start with this version.
